In a zombie outbreak… you can't defend the whole house… so you pick one room.
So you pick the living room. It's the biggest… Three windows, and two doors.
Every window is a door for them.
So you go small. One door, no windows… right in the middle of the house, like a bathroom or a walk-in closet… Even Ready.gov says it, an inside room with as few windows as possible.
Then you fix its door like last time… you drive three-inch screws into the stud, and wedge a bar under the handle. You already know how.
Now, your item box… Water, food, a flashlight with spare batteries, a radio, and a charger, all in one chest… Pretty much FEMA's own list.
And while you're packing, you cut your hand on a nail from the barricade, and it won't stop bleeding… So you spray it, put the bandage on… and press down hard for a full fifteen minutes, no peeking.
Day three, you save your game… Congratulations… you have a safe room.
